# planning — plan up front, questions on deviation

> The everyday cycle lives in AGENTS.md. This skill captures the owner's
> planning workflow for bigger work. Vendor methods that survive under
> parts/ are optional references — nothing here outranks the owner's chat.

## The workflow (owner's, recorded 2026-09-19)

1. **Overall plan first.** Sketch the whole plan at the start and surface it
   to the owner — before execution begins.
2. **Execute.** Follow the plan.
3. **Any deviation → ask.** The moment something unexpected appears — the
   plan said "write a parser" but a ready one turned up, or the work is not
   covered by the plan — stop and put questions to the owner before acting
   on the deviation. This is the same rule as AGENTS.md step 6, applied to
   plan drift specifically: the plan is a contract with the owner, and
   silently re-planning is widening its frame.
4. **Write the plan to disk at the end of planning** — not during, not as a
   running log. Once the plan is stable (and owner-corrected where needed),
   it lands as a file so the next session does not rebuild it from chat.
   During execution the file records confirmed verdicts and deviations in
   minimal form — a protocol of decisions, not a task list.

## Which part when

| Situation | Part |
|---|---|
| Sharpen a fuzzy goal into a measurable objective | `parts/define-goal/` |
| Write the plan file itself (bite-sized tasks, per-task test cycle) | `parts/writing-plans/` |

Archived 2026-09-19 by owner verdict (zero uses, wrong fit): code-to-prd,
spec-driven-workflow, spec-to-repo (all → `_archive/2026-09-19-skills-planning-purge/`),
executing-plans (duplicate of writing-plans). They remain retrievable.

## Rules

- The plan is the owner's contract: deviations are asked, not assumed.
- Plan file placement: next to the work it plans (project folder) or in the
  workspace root for workspace-level rebuilds — never a vendor default path.
- Skills to reach for while planning: `relevance-scan` (what exists),
  `mcp` part `mcp-usage` (which tools), `grill-me` (stress-test the plan
  with the owner on request), `brainstorming` (idea generation before the
  plan, stays top-level).
